description: National CDC NWSS wastewater viral activity level (WVAL) for SARS-CoV-2, influenza A, or RSV — the leading public signal for near-term respiratory infection and test-demand trends, published weekly (Fridays) from ~800+ US sewershed sites. Returns the latest week's national level (Very Low/Low/Moderate/High/Very High, population-weighted across reporting sites), the category breakdown, and a week-over-week trend. Example: wastewater_national_trend({"pathogen":"SARS-CoV-2"}).

pathogen.description: Pathogen: "SARS-CoV-2" (aliases: covid, covid-19), "Influenza A" (aliases: flu, influenza), or "RSV". Default SARS-CoV-2.

weeks.description: Trailing weeks of history to include (default 4, max 12).

name: wastewater_national_trend
title: Wastewater National Trend
